Title: COLORFUL Launches CVN B650M GAMING FROZEN Motherboard for AMD AM5 Processors and Ryzen AI
URL: https://www.thefpsreview.com/2024/03/29/colorful-launches-cvn-b650m-gaming-frozen-motherboard-for-amd-am5-processors-and-ryzen-ai/
Published: 2024-03-29T13:37:58.000Z
Author: Peter Brosdahl
Highlights:
COLORFUL has launched the CVN B650M GAMING FROZEN V14 M-ATX motherboard for the AM5 socket with support for Ryzen AI and 7000/8000 Series CPUs. The CVN B650M GAMING FROZEN V14 is a budget-friendly model featuring a custom white theme. Up to 192 GB DDR5-7600 is supported and includes 2x M.2 PCIe 5.0 slots. Network connectivity includes AX200 WiFi 6, Bluetooth 5.2, and 2.5 Gbit LAN. Display connectivity includes 1x HDMI 1.4 and 1x DP 1.2. Power for the B650M is provided by a 12+2+1 power phase solution which is a slight step down from its non-M counterpart which features a 16+2+1 phase design but can go for as much as $100 higher.

...

#### Specifications (via Official Product Page)

- Model: CVN B650M GAMING FROZEN V14
- Product Series: CVN series
- Chipset: AMD B650
- Processor Supports AMD Ryzen 7000 series processors that fit the AMD AM5 slot of the motherboard
- Memory 4 DDR5 memory sockets are provided, which can support up to 192 GB of memory (a single socket can support up to 48 GB of memory, * Please visit www.colorful.cn for the latest memory compatibility list)
- Support DDR5-7600 (OC)/7400 (OC)/7200 (OC)/7000 (OC)/6800 (OC)/6600 (OC)/6400 (OC)/6200 (OC)/6000 (OC)/5800 (OC)/5600 (OC)/5400 (OC)/5200 (OC)/5000 (OC)/4800MHz memory
- Support Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) memory technology and dual channel memory technology 
- SATA Ports 2 M.2 slots and 4 SATA 6Gb/s hard disk interfaces, and supports creating RAID 0, RAID 1, RAID 10 RAID with SATA or M.2 NVMe hard disk devices
- M.2_1 slot: supports 2242/2260/2280 M.2 SSD (PCIe 5.0/4.0 x4, CPU channel)
- M.2_2 slot: supports 2242/2260/2280 M.2 SSD (PCIe 5.0/4.0 x4, CPU channel)
- Board I/O Rear I/O : 4×USB 2.0, 2×USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A, 1×USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A, 1×USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C, 1×DP 1.2, supporting up to 4K 60Hz resolution, 1×HDMI 1.4, Supports up to 4K 30Hz resolution -1×2.5G, 2×Wi-Fi 6 antenna, 6×Audio interfaces (audio input/audio output/microphone), 1×BIOS update button
- On board: 1×CPU fan pin, 3×System fan pins, 1×water cooling pump pin, 2×USB 2.0 pins expandable 4 USB 2.0 Type-A interfaces, 1×USB 3.2 Gen 1 pin expandable 2 USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A interfaces, 1×USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C slot expandable 1 USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C interface, 2×5V 3-pin ARGB pins, 2×12V 4-pin RGB pins, 1×Front audio pin, 1×Front panel pin, 1×Speaker pin, 1×Clear CMOS jumper, 1×COM port pin, 1×BIOS burner pin, 1×POST card pin
- Expansion Slots: 1×PCIe 5.0 x16 slot, 1×PCIe x16 slot (supports PCIe 4.0 x4 specifications) 1×PCIe 4.0 x1 slot
- BIOS 128M UEFI, support multiple languages
- Power Management Support: S3/S4 wake-up, network S5 wake-up, support USB wake-up, support timing boot, call boot
- Hardware Monitor: CPU fan speed is controllable, system fan speed is controllable, CPU temperature monitoring, system temperature monitoring, and each group of voltage monitoring
- Network: LAN RTL8125 2.5Gbit LAN, AX200 WiFi 6 wireless network card, Bluetooth 5.2
- Audio: Audio Realtek ALC897 high fidelity decoding chip, Support up to 7.1 channels
- Form Factor: M-ATX
- Dimensions: 245mm x 245 mm
